interface.joint_audit_only: Add --audit-only and exactly two --peer-recovery-data ARM=PATH arguments. Requires launch_gpu.py guard. Writes the common token-audit path exclusively; loads base tokenizer only, no model.
interface.training: Add --output <new-directory>. No peer flags: all peer paths are inherited from the audited inventory. Recompute all identities, contexts, encodings, schedule, input bytes, base/initial adapter inventories and runtime before model load. Require exact audit equality.
interface.settings_override: No CLI overrides for frozen optimization/schedule/settings. Base path and canonical final adapter path fixed; logical device must be cuda:0 under launcher guard.

behavior: Single PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, initial_adapter, is_trainable=True), existing default LoRA only; fresh AdamW and no optimizer restore.
Exactly100 optimizer updates, each BC0,recovery0,...,BC3,recovery3; 400 BC + 400 recovery exposures. Private RNG seeds613300/613301; shuffle existing permutation on wrap.
Action+EOS-only crossentropy, each accumulation window weighted by actual target token counts, clip1 and no token padding/resampling.
Only complete step100 final checkpoint qualifies. Partial/failing runs retain metrics, started-forward/completed-backward exposure log and incomplete summary.

Dataset hashes, source hashes, runtime package versions, original full base model inventory, original adapter full inventory against prior completed-learning locks, per-example token hashes/counts, exact schedule and final adapter inventory are bound.
limitations: No live tokenizer/model/GPU test was permitted; model loading, token audit and optimizer paths require later adopted guarded execution.
This module does not authorize training or implement acquisition/diagnostic gates, controller, or held-out evaluation. Parent must enforce those gates and outer owned-process wall deadline.
